description: This file defines a custom exception class 'ReportParameterNotFoundException' that extends 'AbstractPlatformResourceNotFoundException'. It is used to signal that a specific report parameter was not found, identified by an ID.

classes.name: ReportParameterNotFoundException
classes.description: Custom runtime exception indicating a missing report parameter, extends a generic 'not found' exception.

methods.name: ReportParameterNotFoundException
methods.description: Constructor that creates an exception message for a missing report parameter identified by ID.
